description: This file defines the class TimeDuration, an immutable Java class that represents a period of time with various constructors, including from explicit time units and from Calendar objects. It includes methods for comparison, string representation, serialization, and arithmetic with Calendar instances, and defines utility methods for encoding/decoding durations.

classes.name: TimeDuration
classes.description: An immutable Java class representing a duration of time, with fields for years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds. This class provides multiple constructors, comparison and utility methods, and supports adding the duration to Calendar objects.

classes.name: TimeDuration.NullDuration
classes.description: A subclass of TimeDuration representing a zero duration, used as a singleton instance to avoid creating multiple zero-duration objects.
